name: Nightclaw Druids reputation
summary: A neutral Zephras Isle faction. Earn reputation from the Shadowgale Forest storyline, then by handing in Al'Aketh Cultist's Ears. Vayn Moongaze (den entrance, 64, 36) sells level 7-10 Skyborne-style armour recipes, a pet and a shoulder transmog.
steps: Neutral to mid-Friendly: Unnerving Silence (Lotheluum Starbreeze, Valanaar), then the Shadowgale Forest storyline (starts with Elegael Thornpaw behind a tree at 61.8, 39.1)
Then Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears (Vayn Moongaze): hand in 10 ears to unlock the repeatable
Friendly onward: More Al'Aketh Ears, 5 ears for 200 rep
About 75 ears to Friendly, 150 to Honored, 300 to Revered, 525 to Exalted
keyGear: Friendly: Blacksmithing Cloudy/Azure Skyforged plans, Leatherworking Gustwoven/Windraveled patterns, Tailoring Stormsewn patterns
Honored: more plans (legguards, chainmail, harness, trousers, jerkin, vest, leggings)
Exalted: Nightclaw Mantle transmog and the '...of the Nightclaw' title

name: Skyborne Druid form quests
summary: Skyborne Druids earn Bear Form at 10 on Zephras Isle, and Cat Form at 20 through a chain via Moonglade.
steps: 10 · The Great Ursera Spirit: Lotheluum Starbreeze, Valanaar (64, 75); meet the bear spirit on the east island
10 · Strength and Mercy: Urs'endris (70, 62); kill the mad Ur'endra in the Shen'dar Highlands cave (54, 65) → Bear Form, Growl, Maul
20 · The Great Cat Spirit: Mathrengyl Bearwalker (Darnassus 35, 8) or Turak Runetotem (Thunder Bluff 77, 28)
20 · The Great Windborne Cat Spirit: Dendrite Starblaze, Nighthaven (56, 31)
20 · Speak to the Avatar of Saeyleenan (Moonglade 44, 74); click the cat statue inside the barrow den (72, 62) for stealth
20 · Collect the Relics of the Claw, Fang and Silent Shadow from the cat statues; return to the Avatar
20 · Final quest from Dendrite Starblaze, hand in at your Druid trainer → Cat Form, Claw, Prowl, Rip

name: Dwarf Shaman totem quests
summary: Dwarf Shamans (new in Forever) unlock their four totems through one quest per element.
steps: 4 · Call of Earth: Teo Hammerstorm, Anvilmar; 2 Iceclaw Bear Pendants from Frostmane Troll Whelps; drink Earth Sapta at the Earth Spirit Stone (25, 62) → Earth Totem, Stoneskin Totem

10 · Call of Fire: Bruegs Kindleborn (path from 87, 47 in Dun Morogh), then Braldir Ashmantle in Loch Modan (32, 66); Fire Tar and a Reagent Pouch; drink Fire Sapta on the peak (32, 65), defeat the fire manifestation → Fire Totem, Searing Totem

20 · Call of Water: Norric Lochthane (Loch Modan 42, 19), Hervdana Saegrund's cave (Wetlands 66, 76); fill waterskins at Stonewatch Falls (Redridge 74, 62) and near Astranaar (Ashenvale 37, 52); drink Water Sapta at the Forgotten Shrine, Westfall (48, 60) → Water Totem, Healing Stream Totem
30 · Call of Air: from your trainer; Veyric Thundervein, Arathi Highlands (60, 28), via the rocky path near the Shard of Myzrael → Air Totem
tips: Fire quest mobs reach level 14: group up
The Water quest is a long trip: use flight paths, hearth and the Menethil-Darkshore boat

name: Cozy Sleeping Bag
summary: A treasure-trail item: lie on it for up to 3 Well-Rested stacks (+1% XP each, kept through death). It counts as a rested area, the whole party can use it, and it has a 1-hour cooldown.
steps: Alliance: Nailed Plank at Alexston Farmstead, Westfall (37, 50)
Burned-Out Remains in the southern Barrens (46, 74), then Stepping Stones
Pocket Litter at the hillside camp near Sun Rock Retreat, Stonetalon; optionally rekindle the campfire; then the Mound of Dirt just east
Carved Figurine on a ledge of the Stonewrought Dam, Loch Modan (49, 12)
Hillsbrad: climb the leaning cart at the gap in the Thoradin Wall, then click the Hastily Rolled-Up Satchel → Cozy Sleeping Bag
Horde: same objects, starting in The Barrens, then Westfall, Stonetalon, Loch Modan, Hillsbrad
tips: Lie down for about 3 minutes for all 3 stacks
It vanishes if you move about 100 yards away
Stacks with Camping buffs and food

name: Scarlet Banner puzzle
summary: A cosmetic camp banner: collect four Echoes from graves, then activate them at the matching statues in the Scarlet Monastery Library.
steps: Arathi Echo: grave behind the barn at Go'shek Farm, Arathi Highlands (62, 55)
Theramore Echo: Theramore Graveyard across the bridge, Dustwallow Marsh (64, 42)
Swamp Echo: grave by a tree at Splinterspear Junction, Swamp of Sorrows (17, 54)
Graveyard Echo: back corner near the south mausoleum inside SM Graveyard
In SM Library, find the four statues
Blake Godwyn (warrior): use the Swamp Echo
Primwell Skye (mage): Arathi Echo
Janet Kaitway (paladin): Theramore Echo
Brother Paxwell (priest): Graveyard Echo → Scarlet Banner
tips: Standing near a statue gives a buff naming it
Wrong order means resetting the dungeon

name: Zephras Isle to Ironforge (Alliance Skyborne)
summary: How a new High Order Skyborne gets from Zephras Isle to the Alliance capitals.
steps: Go to Valanaar on the south side of Zephras Isle
Board the skyship at the dock with Alliance and Kirin Tor banners (to Dalaran)
In Dalaran, take the Stormwind portal in the Violet Citadel
Arrive in the Stormwind Mage Tower
Take the Deeprun Tram from the Dwarven District to Ironforge
